pages.title: Pink Kush
pages.text: $(bold)Base THC:$() 19% — $(bold)Base CBD:$() 6%$(br)$(bold)Effect:$() Regeneration (10 seconds)$(br)$(bold)Extra Effects:$() None (THC ≤ 20)$(br)$(br)Requires Infused Butter — craft from weed + butter in a Crafting Table.$(br)$(br)$(bold)Synthesizer Reagents:$()$(br)Red Tulip + Infused Butter + Pink Dye
Grind Pink Kush Buds in the Grinder (2 weed) or Manual Grinder (1 weed).
Plant on farmland or in a Grow Pot. Harvest at age 10. Get seeds via DNA route or Mutator.
Pack weed into a bag for selling to the Stoner Villager or compact storage.
